error[ZBX-E0226]: can't use a CDI spec
  while  reading the CDI specs in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cdi (or ~/.config/cdi),
         /var/run/cdi, /etc/cdi
  cause  example.json: it is not valid JSON (at cdiVersion)
  file   example.json
  field  cdiVersion
  fix    correct the file, or move it out of the CDI directories
  more   zbx explain E0226
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0226.html
